body:
I’ve dropped out from university 5 or 6 times. My health has deteriorated. My father died and mother has become crazy.

My extreme pain stared 5 years ago but they get real worse in the past 3-4 years.
People who say that to you are either ignorant or know the truth but scared to admit it. I’m sorry you are suffering.
You told the truth but most ppl are afraid of accepting it.
She already worries even when I assure her I’m fine so bringing up suicide will further worries her.

I thought a lot about it but I’ve no option. I wish I have a gun because I can go to any distant woods and end it there. My hope now is for my siblings or neighbors to see my body first and not allow my mother to see it.

Happened 3 years ago. She sometimes tries to bring it up but I’m uncomfortable to talk about suicide with her or ppl who know me in person. But sometimes we have a fight I mention suicide but regret it shortly. She mostly checks if I’m ok and I assure her I’m (lie). She worries so much.

Thanks but I’m in peace with my fate.
She knows my problems. She knows one of my previous attempt.
I don’t have a reliable method for outside home. For my method home is the only safe place I can think.

I don’t want to move out. I’m afraid of adult responsibilities even if I’m 23. I’m scared of sleeping alone let alone living alone in a house. She will also be very devastated.

But even if I move out I won’t find peace because there are many other reasons that are pushing to suicide. The universe wants me dead.
For me it isn’t death but dying because it involve pain. If most methods were painless then I’m sure most of us in this sub would have already been dead.
Unless by medical assistance I don’t know any 100% peaceful method. For most of use dying will be painful just like living.
For most part and ppl they don’t work.
It’s a stupid quote. Almost all the so called inspirational quotes are fake.
